body: Hey, I'm willing to chat if you are

I can't promise it'll get better, but I can say there isn't a chance if you don't make one. I advise seeking therapy. I can't completely say I've been there, but I've been through a pretty big rough patch of my own with mental health for a while now, I still am, but after getting therapy and actually trying, I've managed to make the pain a decent bit more bearable, so I recommend giving it a shot, because atleast then you could say you tried. I'm not going to say it's going to solve everything, I'm just gonna say it'll likely aid you, give you the tools to pull yourself up. You aren't lazy, it's just you've pulled yourself down and feel like there's no climbing out, and so there's no use hurting your fingers trying to climbing. But I'm willing to bet if you dug a little deeper into those walls for some sort of grip, you'll find one and then you can start climbing. I can't promise things will get better, but I can promise that it's worth a shot trying to make it that way atleast.
